# Field (FieldDef) format

> Generated by `tools/` from the inputs in `source/`. Every statement below is backed by assembly metadata, IL, or a supplied export sample.
> Anything that could not be proven from those inputs is marked **Unknown** rather than guessed.

**Source table:** `MET_FIELDDEF` · **Confidence:** Verified

A field is a `FieldDef` row owned by a `TypeDef`. `dbName` is the physical column; this is why `dyn_*` tables have positional `F1..Fn` columns rather than readable names.

| Column | XSD type | Nullable in schema | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|
| `typeDefId` | long | yes | Owning MET_TYPEDEF row. |
| `orderNumber` | int | yes | Display order. |
| `fieldInfoType` | long | yes | Field kind discriminator — value set Unknown. |
| `dbName` | string | yes | Physical column name in the owner's table. |
| `ID` | long | yes | Primary key. |
| `relationType` | long | yes | Set when the field expresses a relation. |
| `caption` | string | yes | Display name. |
| `Settings` | base64Binary | yes | Opaque settings payload — contents Unknown. |

Column meanings left blank are **Unknown**: the column name alone is not
evidence of its semantics.
